blogs.title: From Blocky to Butterfly: A Smarter Way to Fine-Tune AI Giants
blogs.description: This post breaks down the evolution of 'Orthogonal Finetuning' (OFT). We'll explore why simply chopping big AI models into isolated blocks limits their potential and how borrowing a clever mathematical trick from signal processing—the 'butterfly structure'—allows us to create dense, flexible transformations using far fewer parameters. Learn how BOFT offers a smoother, more expressive path to adapting massive models like LLMs and image generators.

blogs.title: The Secret Life of Matrices: Why Fast Fourier Transforms Are Key to Efficient AI Training
blogs.description: Did you know the algorithm that speeds up your music streaming (Fast Fourier Transform) is now helping train artificial intelligence? This article explains the surprising connection between classical signal processing and modern machine learning. We dive into the 'information transmission' framework proposed in recent research, showing how viewing matrix math as a data-flow network led to the creation of BOFT, a method that drastically cuts training costs while preserving model quality.

blogs.title: Beyond LoRA: Preserving Neural Angles with Orthogonal Butterfly Finetuning
blogs.description: Everyone knows LoRA, but is it the best tool for every job? This deep dive compares popular fine-tuning methods against the new 'Orthogonal Butterfly' (BOFT) technique. We explain the core philosophy of preserving 'pairwise angles' between neurons to keep pre-trained knowledge intact, and why BOFT's unique blend of orthogonality and sparse factorization might offer better stability and generalization for everything from chatbots to text-to-image art generators.
